title: 第1089章 人心难测第1088章 狼狈为奸
lines: 胡仙海站了起来，看着一众兄弟，重重的跪在了地上。
看着胡仙海的举动，所有人的眼神当中终于是出现了波动。
“老大，各位兄弟，当黑子传回那里的斥候兄弟全部失联的时候，我就应该让他不要去那里，是我误判了风险，这一战是我之错！”
“大海，是我的错，我本就不应该如此鲁莽的去打这一战，我......”萧羽拽着胡仙海的胳膊道。
“你们两个在这里演戏吗？！”血族的一位强者突然站了起来。
“你们知不知道，这一战死了多少人？牺牲了多少兄弟，我血月军团的统领血魅魉战死了！星族三大军团长团灭，现在我们四个军团的人数还凑不齐一个军团！魂九天也只剩下了半条命，若不是他魂族的秘法，他也死了！”
“你再说一句试试？！”蛮儿站了起来，“你们的人死了，我们的人呢？我蛮族三万人现在只剩下不到一万人！夜族的先知和长辈统统战死！落日军团减员超过一半，灵佑军团减员超过七成，你们的人的命是命，我们的人命就不是命了吗？！”
蛮儿喝道。
双方顿时剑拔弩张起来。
“怎么？这是准备搞内讧吗？”小刀从戮神当中走了出来冷笑道。
看着一身黑衣的小刀，众人均是感受到了压力。
“就你们这些废物，能活着还得感谢你们自己死去的那些兄弟，你们不想着如何给他们报仇，却在这里指责到底是谁的错？！你们有什么资格？还是说你们自己觉得你们能够做得比他们两个更好？！”小刀是真的怒了。
他的话当真是字字诛心。
“我实话告诉你们，若不是这个小子不想放弃你们这些废物，他现在就可以去仙界，没有你们这些废物的拖累，他会成长的更快！到时候，你们就算是都死了，整个天元宇宙被屠干净了，又如何？只要他还活着，就可以为你们报仇，他也有能力再重建一个天元宇宙！”
小刀的话让所有人都是哑口无言。
“小刀。”萧羽轻轻唤了一声。
“别拦着我，让我骂醒这些自以为是的混蛋！”小刀大声道。
“萧羽现在是天境四重天！以他的天赋再加上我，只要他达到天境六重天，他一个人就可以横推整个凡界宇宙，真仙之下他无敌！可是他真正的软肋在哪里？还不是你们？”
小刀沉声道。
“如果他真的有这个本事，为何还需要我们的帮助？”血族的那位强者依旧倔强的道。
“哼，你问的很好，我想反问一句，你们真的觉得是他需要你们还是你们需要他？”
“这里你们已经见过了吧，这个世界已经无限接近于一个真实的世界了，他只要将萧族的人都装进这个世界当中，那么他完全可以去任何一个地方，而不用去管你们的死活！也不必去管天元宇宙的存在与否。”
“但是他走了之后呢？你们这些废物连十大世家都打不过，更不用说外宇宙的强者，你们的实力之所以能够提升的如此之快是因为谁？还不是因为他？”
小刀的话响彻在每一个人的心头。
“还有你，萧羽。你的仁心不一定会换回感恩，你想带着他们一起我不反对，但是以后若是再有人敢对你产生质疑，在我这里只有一个字：杀！”小刀的话让所有人都是心头一颤。
content_en:
Hu Xianhai stood up, looked at the brothers, and knelt heavily on the ground.
Looking at Hu Xianhai's actions, everyone's eyes finally showed fluctuations.
"Boss, brothers, when Heizi reported that all the scout brothers there had lost contact, I should have told him not to go there. I misjudged the risk, and this battle is my fault!"
"Haidai, it's my fault. I shouldn't have fought this battle so recklessly. I..." Xiao Yu said, pulling Hu Xianhai's arm.
"Are you two acting here?!" A strong man from the vampire clan suddenly stood up.
"Do you know how many people died in this battle? How many brothers were sacrificed. The leader of my Blood Moon Legion, the Blood Demon King, died in the battle! The three legion commanders of the Star Clan were wiped out, and now our four legions are still less than one legion! Hun Jiutian only has half his life left. If it weren't for his Soul Clan's secret method, he would also be dead!"
"Try saying something again?!" Man'er stood up, "Your people are dead, but where are our people? There are only less than 10,000 of our 30,000 barbarians left! All the prophets and elders of the Night Clan died in battle! The Sunset Army has lost more than half of its members, and the Lingyou Army has lost more than 70% of its members. Your people's lives are lives, but our lives are not lives?!"
Man'er shouted.
The two sides immediately became tense.
"What? Are you preparing for internal strife?" Xiao Dao came out from among the gods and sneered.
Looking at the knife dressed in black, everyone felt the pressure.
"You losers, you are alive thanks to your dead brothers. You don't think about how to avenge them, but here you blame whose fault it is?! What qualifications do you have? Or do you think you can do better than the two of them?!" Xiaodao was really angry.
His words were truly heartbreaking.
"I tell you the truth, if this kid didn't want to give up on you trash, he could go to the fairy world now. Without the drag of you trash, he would grow faster! By then, even if you are all dead and the entire Tianyuan Universe is slaughtered, so what? As long as he is still alive, he can avenge you, and he will also have the ability to rebuild another Tianyuan Universe!"
Xiao Dao's words left everyone speechless.
"Knife." Xiao Yu called softly.
"Don't stop me, let me wake up these self-righteous bastards!" Xiaodao said loudly.
"Xiao Yu is now at the fourth level of heaven! With his talent and me, as long as he reaches the sixth level of heaven, he can dominate the entire mortal world by himself. He is invincible under the true immortal! But where is his real weakness? Isn't it you?"
Xiao Dao said solemnly.
"If he really has this ability, why does he still need our help?" The strong man from the vampire clan still said stubbornly.
"Hmph, you asked a good question. I want to ask a question, do you really think he needs you or do you need him?"
"You have seen this place, right? This world is infinitely close to the real world. As long as he puts all the people of the Xiao clan into this world, he can go anywhere without having to worry about your life or death! There is no need to worry about the existence of the Tianyuan Universe."
"But what happens after he leaves? You losers can't even defeat the top ten aristocratic families, let alone the strong men in the outer universe. Who is the reason why your strength has improved so quickly? Isn't it because of him?"
Xiaodao's words resounded in everyone's heart.
"And you, Xiao Yu. Your kindness may not be replaced by gratitude. I have no objection if you want to take them with you, but if anyone dares to question you again in the future, I have only one word here: kill!" Xiaodao's words made everyone's hearts tremble.
title_en: Chapter 1089: People’s hearts are unpredictable Chapter 1088: Complicity
